description:
Create a 3D model of a connecting rod in FreeCAD. 

Goal: Create a connecting rod with an 'I-beam' profile shank.

Specifications:
1. Overall Shape: Two cylindrical ends connected by a straight rectangular shank.
2. Dimensions:
   - Center-to-Center Distance: 100 mm
   - Big End: Outer Diameter 40 mm, Inner Hole Diameter 30 mm
   - Small End: Outer Diameter 20 mm, Inner Hole Diameter 12 mm
   - Shank Width: 12 mm
   - Part Thickness: 10 mm
3. I-Beam Feature (Weight Reduction):
   - Create a rectangular pocket on the flat face of the shank.
   - Pocket size: 60 mm long x 6 mm wide.
   - Pocket depth: 2 mm.
   - CRITICAL: This pocket must be applied to BOTH the top and bottom faces of the shank (creating a central web 6 mm thick).

Save the final model to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/connecting_rod.FCStd'.
